title: melicope macrocarpa
intro: Melicope macrocarpa, commonly known as the Broad-leaved Neem or Hawea Neem, is a plant species native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to aid in wound healing and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Melicope macrocarpa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes that exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents present in this plant make it a promising candidate for further research into its potential medicinal applications.
